setup: Position a box or low bench inside the rack at a height that places the hip crease below the top of the knee when seated.
Unrack the barbell across your rear deltoids and step back so your calves are close to the box.
Set your feet into an exaggerated wide stance, with toes pointed moderately outward, and brace your core tightly.
steps: Hinge at the hips and push your knees actively outward as you descend toward the box.
Sit back fully onto the box under control, releasing hip flexor tension while keeping your torso upright and core rigid.
Pause momentarily on the box without rocking back or bouncing.
Drive aggressively through your feet, spreading the floor apart and extending the hips and knees to return to standing lockout.
instructions.breathing: Inhale deeply and brace your abdominals before initiating the descent; hold your breath through the pause on the box, and exhale past the sticking point on the ascent.
cues: Spread the floor with your feet

common_faults.fault: Crashing down onto the box instead of maintaining control during the eccentric phase.
common_faults.correction: Control your descent by reaching back with the hips and resisting gravity until you make quiet, deliberate contact.

common_faults.fault: Rocking backward on the box and bouncing forward to generate momentum.
common_faults.correction: Pause motionless on the box while keeping the spine braced, then drive straight up without rocking.

common_faults.fault: Letting the knees collapse inward on either descent or ascent.
common_faults.correction: Actively push your knees outward in line with your angled toes throughout the entire rep.

precautions: Ensure the box is sturdy, level, and will not slip during contact.
Set safety pins in the power rack slightly below your seated box height.

name: Barbell Wide-Stance Low Box Squat

sources.title: wger: Low Box Squat - Wide Stance
sources.author: taylorbarbell

summary: A barbell back squat variation performed with an exaggerated wide stance to a below-parallel box, emphasizing hip and adductor recruitment while breaking the eccentric-concentric chain.
